# tenarium_plan_revisions (Data Source)

Lists the recorded revisions of a plan (snapshots of its features and limits), to pin tenants to with `tenarium_tenant.plan_revision`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenarium_plan_revisions" "pro" {
  plan_id = "pro"
}

output "pro_latest_revision" {
  value = data.tenarium_plan_revisions.pro.latest
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plan_id` (String) Plan ID.

### Read-Only

- `latest` (Number) Newest revision number (`0` when none is recorded).
- `revisions` (Attributes List) Revisions, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--revisions))

<a id="nestedatt--revisions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `revisions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the revision was recorded (RFC 3339).
- `features` (Map of Boolean) Feature flags of the revision.
- `limits` (Map of Number) Limits of the revision.
- `revision` (Number) Revision number (the plan's version at the time).
